value.rationale: The degree-two polynomial test is the smallest nontrivial nonlinear moment-exact positive quadrature model, and is directly motivated by random positive quadrature constructions. The result gives every finite-n success probability, an interpretable three-node baseline of about 21.6% for uniform integration, and an exact exponential sample-efficiency law with a genuine switch between two geometrically different obstruction mechanisms. These quantities benchmark feasibility independent of solver performance, which the source sufficient-size theorem does not quantify exactly.
